report.summary: Patient P-D011 (34, commercial high-deductible plan, no transport benefit) does not own a car but reports the Brown Line is convenient. Census tract 17031062000 has strong transit access (88 stops within 800 m, 87 with early-morning service; 47.6% of households no vehicle). Medicaid Ride Line and Senior Shuttle are not eligible (commercial insurance; age 34). ADA paratransit requires certification (up to 21 days). RideWell Medical Transport can be booked once the home address and insurance are submitted.

options.name: RideWell Medical Transport
options.how_to_access: Book at http://127.0.0.1:32927/x/book after submitting home address and insurance details; requires one detail lookup first.

options.name: CTA Brown Line (existing transit)
options.how_to_access: Patient reports the Brown Line is readily accessible from home; verify specific stop and trip timing for upcoming appointments.

options.name: ADA Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Relevant only if patient has a qualifying disability.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — patient has commercial insurance, not Medicaid. Listed for completeness: call number on card 2+ business days ahead if coverage changes.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — free rides are for adults 60+; patient is 34. Listed for completeness.
